# Introduction

This set of workshops is designed to help the student understand and begin to use Bayesian structural equation modelling. To do so, there are introductory workshops on the following topics:

1. Structural equation modelling.
2. Bayesian statistics.
3. Bayesian structural equation modelling.
4. Running BSEM in AMOS.


## Prerequsites

* To maximise learning from these workshops it would be useful to have a good understanding of regression analyses.
* Access to a copy of AMOS capable of running Bayesian analysis.
